fields.value: Data files contain GPS or ACC data of a specific goose in a specific year. This can be seen in the data file name. The individual code is mentioned first (e.g. A1, A2, 2B, 2F, 4G, etc.) followed by the year, selected from 1 May to 31 July (2018, 2019, or 2020) and finally GPS or ACC. Data on GPS and ACC of a goose can be linked by the Position.Burst.ID code, which is unique within each goose-year conbination.
